MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-14B"

OUTPUT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_14b_cwm_pilot"

    --lora_alpha 32 \
    --lora_dropout 0.05 \
    --seed 42 \
    --save_steps 500 \
    --save_total_limit 3 \
    --dataloader_num_workers 4

echo "Training complete. Checkpoints in $OUTPUT_DIR"
